name: What is the average cost of kitchen countertop replacement in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of kitchen countertop replacement in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen countertop replacement in the Bay Area varies significantly based on the material chosen, the total square footage, edge profiles, sink cutouts, and any necessary demolition or plumbing work. For instance, laminate is generally more affordable, while natural stone or high-end quartz can be a greater investment.
